title: Astrocytes regulate axonal mitochondrial transport deficits in C9ORF72 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis motor neurons
title_zh: 星形胶质细胞调节C9ORF72肌萎缩侧索硬化症运动神经元轴突线粒体运输缺陷
abstract: Abstract Disrupted axonal transport and astrocyte dysfunction are implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Here we show these processes are linked—human-induced pluripotent stem-cell-derived astrocytes carrying the C9ORF72 mutation disrupt mitochondrial axonal transport and mitochondrial function in cocultured motor neurons (MNs). Conversely, isogenic gene-corrected astrocytes or boosting astrocytic mitochondrial bioenergetics rescue axonal mitochondrial transport deficits in C9ORF72 MNs. Our results delineate a non-cell-autonomous role for astrocytes in regulating mitochondrial transport along axons in ALS models.
abstract_zh: 摘要：轴突运输障碍和星形胶质细胞功能失调与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）相关。本研究表明这两种过程相互关联——携带C9ORF72突变的人类诱导多能干细胞来源的星形胶质细胞会破坏共培养运动神经元（MNs）的轴突线粒体运输和线粒体功能。相反，等位基因基因修正的星形胶质细胞或增强星形胶质细胞线粒体能量代谢可恢复C9ORF72 MNs的轴突线粒体运输缺陷。我们的结果阐明了星形胶质细胞在ALS模型中调节轴突线粒体运输的非细胞自体作用。
